name: translation
meaning: Converting C source into an executable through compilation and linking.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: format conversion
meaning: A printf instruction such as %d that specifies how to interpret a matching argument.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: integer division
meaning: Division of integer operands that discards the fractional part toward zero.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: undefined behavior
meaning: A situation for which the C standard imposes no requirements on program behavior.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: short-circuit evaluation
meaning: Skipping a later Boolean condition once the result is already determined.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: bit mask
meaning: An integer pattern used to select or change chosen bits.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: shadowing
meaning: An inner declaration hiding an outer name within its scope.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: fallthrough
meaning: Continuing from one switch label into following statements without leaving the switch.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: counted loop
meaning: A loop that advances a counter while its condition permits.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: array index
meaning: A zero-based position used to access an array element.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: sizeof
meaning: An operator giving storage size in C bytes; an array object size differs from a pointer size.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: character constant
meaning: A single-quoted C character constant; an ordinary one has type int.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: null terminator
meaning: The zero character that marks the end of a C string.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: bounded formatting
meaning: Formatting into storage with an explicit capacity and checking truncation or error.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: validated conversion
meaning: Parsing text while checking whether digits were consumed, the full input matched and the value fit.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: function prototype
meaning: A declaration specifying a C function’s return and parameter types.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: dereference
meaning: Using a valid pointer to designate the object it points to.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: pass-by-value
meaning: Giving a function a copy of each supplied argument value, including pointer values.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.
